name: Name on the One
why_it_works: A name heard three times on a strong beat sticks without the viewer trying. The brain stores rhythm before meaning, so {{brand}} gets remembered as a sound, and people hum it later without knowing why.

hook.pattern: Open cold on the sung brand name over a hard downbeat, no intro, then the one-line promise.
examples: We wrote {{brand}} a theme song. It is stuck in your head.
Fifteen seconds. One song. You will hum {{brand}} tonight.

variables.name: brand
variables.description: Business name, ideally 2-3 syllables when sung

variables.name: signature_item
variables.description: The one thing they are known for
variables.example: skin fade with a hot towel

variables.name: rhyme_line
variables.description: A short line that rhymes with the brand name or signature item
variables.example: fresh as the day you were made

variables.name: offer
variables.description: Simple reason to come in this week

beats.purpose: hook: sung brand name on the downbeat

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photo of the {{brand}} storefront sign at golden hour, bold front-on framing, warm light, sign fills the upper third, street at {{neighborhood}} softly blurred

beats.purpose: verse line: what they do, rhymed

visual.prompt: Close-up hands making the {{signature_item}} at {{brand}}, quick rhythmic motion timed to a beat, warm practical light, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16

beats.purpose: repeat the name with the place

visual.prompt: Vertical wide shot inside {{brand}}, regulars laughing at the counter, bright natural window light, brand colors visible, eye-level framing

beats.purpose: button: last sung name plus offer

cta: Come hear it in person: {{offer}} at {{brand}}.

craft.notes: Put the stressed syllable of {{brand}} exactly on beat 1 of the bar, every time it appears (three times in 15s). Title placement: first word and last word of the song, so it bookends. The middle line uses one internal rhyme ({{signature_item}} / {{rhyme_line}}) so the ear has a reason to stay. Tempo/feel: 100-108 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick with handclaps on 2 and 4, bright and bouncy; leave a one-beat rest before each sung name so it hits like a stamp.

do_not: Bury the brand name mid-line where it lands on a weak beat
Use a melody that sounds like a famous jingle or real song
Cram more than one selling point into 15 seconds
